a known parameterization divergence (findings R6, fix round 2): the reference brms:::dcom_poisson() takes mu = lambda^(1 / shape), while frmtmb's compois mu is the mean (RTMB::dcompois2), so the two log densities differ at the same numbers (max 94 log units at the block's seed; at mu = 3, shape = 2 brms's mean is 2.737, dev/remeasure-bin2-probe2.R section 6). The row's text reaches brms:::, so the harness records it and does not run it

censored von_mises: frmtmb's von_mises() has no CDF and accepts only weights, so cens() is refused (the adapter by the family's accepts_aterms; frm() with 'cens()/trunc() need a family with a CDF'); brms censors it through pvon_mises(). The row's cens[i] is -1 at the block's seed. The uncensored row (log_lik:389) holds, and the density matches brms::dvon_mises() to 8.9e-16

brms's block draws its thresholds unsorted (rnorm), and at a decreasing pair brms's dcumulative() returns a NEGATIVE category probability (4 of 20 cells at seed 238), which its closed-form helper reproduces; frmtmb's cumulative builds the categories from the threshold gaps and returns NaN with a warning, in categories on either side of the decreasing pair (at draw 5 of bin2-probe3.txt categories 1 and 2 are NaN where brms's category 1 is 0.805). With sorted thresholds every cell agrees, and sratio, cratio and acat agree everywhere, to 2.2e-16 or better (dev/remeasure-bin2-probe3.R, log dev/remeasure-out/probe/bin2-probe3.txt). A fit never reaches decreasing thresholds: frmtmb's threshold map orders them
